record.paper_title: A collection of open problems in celebration of Imre Leader’s 60th birthday
record.context_brief: Boundedness conjecture for Euclidean Ramsey sets
record.original_question: For every pair of positive integers k and n, does there exist a dimension d = d(k,n) such that whenever X is a Ramsey set of size at most n in some Euclidean space, every k-coloring of R^d contains a monochromatic congruent copy of X?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 12.1. For any k ∈ N and n ∈ N, there exists d = d(k, n) ∈ N such that, whenever X is a Ramsey set of size at most n in some Euclidean space, and Rd is k-coloured, there exists a monochromatic congruent copy of X.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A finite set X ⊂ R^m (for some m) is called a Ramsey set if for every positive integer k there exists a positive integer d such that every k-coloring of R^d contains a monochromatic congruent copy of X (i.e., an isometric image of X all of whose points receive the same color).

Prove or disprove the following uniform boundedness statement: For every pair of positive integers k and n, there exists a positive integer d = d(k, n) with the following property. Whenever X is a Ramsey set with |X| ≤ n (lying in some Euclidean space), every k-coloring of R^d contains a monochromatic congruent copy of X.

In other words, show that the required dimension depends only on k and on the cardinality of the Ramsey set X, and not on any further geometric features of X.
artifact.status_search_result: The classical questions of Euclidean Ramsey theory (characterizing Ramsey sets, spherical vs. transitive conjectures) remain open, and no source indicates that this size-uniform boundedness statement has been resolved. It appears to be an open conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Euclidean Ramsey Theory (Graham survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of open problems in Euclidean Ramsey theory; main questions on which sets are Ramsey remain unresolved.
status_evidence.claim: Central problems in Euclidean Ramsey theory, including dimension-bound questions, remain open.

status_evidence.title: Transitive Sets in Euclidean Ramsey Theory (Leader, Russell, Walters)
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces a rival conjecture characterizing Ramsey sets as transitive sets and their subsets; central conjectures still open.
status_evidence.claim: The characterization and structural conjectures around Ramsey sets remain unresolved.
